description: This file contains a JUnit test class named OrderServiceTest for the OpenMRS project. It tests various functionalities of the OrderService, including order creation, retrieval, discontinuation, frequency management, and related domain operations. The tests verify behaviors such as validation, ordering by UUID or number, active orders filtering, order discontinuation, order frequency retiring/unretiring, and many others. The class extends BaseContextSensitiveTest, indicating it runs within an OpenMRS in-memory testing context with a populated database.

classes.name: OrderServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for OrderService in OpenMRS, testing order lifecycle, frequency, retrieval, and management functionalities.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldNotSaveOrderIfOrderDoesntValidate
